- qTypeMax is the maximum value in the quantized type (such as 6 for FP4E2M1).

### MX-Compliant Dynamic Quantization[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html#mx-compliant-dynamic-quantization "Link to this heading")

Dynamic Quantization according to the [OCP Microscaling Formats (MX) Specification v1.0](https://www.opencompute.org/documents/ocp-microscaling-formats-mx-v1-0-spec-final-pdf). The MX-Compliant recipe performs block quantization, quantizing across 32 high-precision elements to produce 32 quantized output values and one E8M0 scaling factor.

TensorRT currently supports MX-Compliant Dynamic Quantization only for the FP8E4M3 vector format, referred to as MXFP8.

The scale computation for a single block is defined as:

scaleE8M0=round_up_to_e8m0(maxi∈{0...blockSize−1}(abs(xi)qTypeMax))

Where:

- E8M0 is an 8-bit exponent-only floating point type, as described in [Supported Types](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/architecture/architecture-overview.html#architecture-overview).
- round_up_to_e8m0 is the computed scale rounded up to the smallest power of two that is greater than or equal to it.
- qTypeMax is the maximum value representable in the quantized type used for data.

The scale computation is repeated for each block, computing a total of inputVolumeblockSize block scales.

### Dynamic Double Quantization[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html#dynamic-double-quantization "Link to this heading")

A variant of Dynamic Quantization, in which the computed scales are also quantized. Putting together the scale computation and scale quantization for a single block:

scalequantized=quantize(maxi∈{0...blockSize−1}(abs(xi)qTypeMax),scale=globalSf)

Where:

- globalSf is an offline-calibrated per-tensor quantization scale (scalar).

TensorRT currently supports Dynamic Double Quantization only for the NVFP4 vector format (FP4E2M1 data, FP8E4M3 scales, block size of 16).

Using qTypeMax=6 and the FP8 range of `[-448,448]`, the quantized scale can be written as:

scalefp8=castToFp8(maxi∈{0...blockSize−1}(abs(xi))6∗globalSf)

The quantized data is computed using block quantization and the computed scales.

To dequantize data that was quantized using Dynamic Double Quantization, two consecutive Dequantize operations are required (which is why it’s called *double* quantization): the first dequantizes the scales using per-tensor quantization, and the second dequantizes the data.

dataDQ=dequantize(dataQ,dequantize(scaleQ,scale=globalSf))

# Quantization Workflows[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html#quantization-workflows "Link to this heading")

TensorRT supports both post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) workflows. These workflows enable you to optimize models for low-precision data types.

The quantization process uses per-tensor, per-channel, or block-wise scaling. The scaling method depends on the layer and data type, which helps preserve model accuracy during conversion.

**Post-Training Quantization (PTQ)**:

- Quantizes a pre-trained model without retraining
- Requires representative “calibration data” set to compute quantization parameters
- Practical when retraining is infeasible due to resource limitations or data privacy concerns
- Can lead to accuracy degradation for complex models or sensitive layers

**Quantization-Aware Training (QAT)**:

- Simulates quantization during training by quantizing weights and activation layers
- Training actively compensates for quantization and dequantization effects
- Generally achieves superior accuracy recovery compared to PTQ
- More time-consuming and requires access to the entire labeled training dataset

The [TensorRT Model Optimizer](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-Model-Optimizer) is a Python toolkit designed to help you create QAT models. These models are fully compatible with the TensorRT optimization and deployment workflows.

The toolkit also provides a PTQ recipe that lets you perform PTQ on models developed in both PyTorch and ONNX formats, streamlining the quantization process across different frameworks.

## Explicit Quantization Overview[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html#explicit-quantization-overview "Link to this heading")

A TensorRT network is explicitly quantized when it contains Quantize and Dequantize layers (Q/DQ for short), which mark exactly where conversions to and from a quantized type occur. The optimizer performs only the conversions dictated by the semantics of the model.

In explicitly quantized networks, the quantization and dequantization operations are represented by `IQuantizeLayer` ([C++](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/_static/c-api/classnvinfer1_1_1_i_quantize_layer.html), [Python](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/_static/python-api/infer/Graph/Layers.html#iquantizelayer)) and `IDequantizeLayer` ([C++](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/_static/c-api/classnvinfer1_1_1_i_dequantize_layer.html), [Python](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/_static/python-api/infer/Graph/Layers.html#idequantizelayer)) nodes in the graph. These will henceforth be referred to as Q/DQ nodes. `IDynamicQuantizeLayer` extends this API for Dynamic Quantization workflows where scales are computed at inference time.

ONNX uses an explicitly quantized representation: when a model in PyTorch or TensorFlow is exported to ONNX, each fake-quantization operation in the framework’s graph is exported as a Quantize node followed by a Dequantize node. Since TensorRT preserves the semantics of these layers, users can expect accuracy that is very close to that seen in the deep learning framework. While optimizations preserve the arithmetic semantics of quantization and dequantization operators, they can change the order of floating-point operations in the model, so results will not be bitwise identical.

**Key Capabilities**:

- **Broad Data Type Support**: Supports INT8, FP8, INT4, and FP4 quantized data types.
- **Precise Placement Control**: Q/DQ nodes specify exactly where conversions to and from quantized types occur, so the optimizer applies only the conversions dictated by the model’s semantics.
- **Compatibility with ONNX Export**: Performing QAT or PTQ in a deep learning framework and exporting to ONNX naturally produces an explicitly quantized model, because ONNX represents fake-quantization operations as Q/DQ pairs.

Calibration is performed before ONNX export (for example, during PTQ or QAT with Model Optimizer), and the resulting scales are embedded directly into the Q/DQ nodes.

## Quantization Granularities[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html#quantization-granularities "Link to this heading")

Quantization granularity refers to how quantization scale factors are applied across a model’s tensors. Selecting the appropriate granularity is a direct lever for balancing the benefits of quantization (such as memory reduction) against its potential drawbacks (such as accuracy loss). A more granular approach increases potential accuracy but also increases the computational and memory overhead of managing multiple scaling factors. TensorRT supports three quantization scale granularities:

1. *Per-tensor quantization*: a single scale value (scalar) is used to scale the entire tensor.
2. *Per-channel quantization*: a scale tensor is broadcast along the given axis - for convolutional neural networks, this is typically the channel axis.
3. *Block quantization*: the tensor is divided into fixed-size blocks, and a scale factor is defined for each block. `IQuantizeLayer` and `IDequantizeLayer` support 1D block shapes (along a single dimension). For 2D block shapes (along the last two dimensions), use `IDynamicQuantizeLayer`.

When using per-channel quantization with Convolutions, the quantization axis must be the output-channel axis. For example, when the weights of 2D convolution are described using `KCRS` notation, `K` is the output-channel axis, and the weights quantization can be described as:

```
For each k in K:
    For each c in C:
        For each r in R:
            For each s in S:
                output[k,c,r,s] := clamp(round(input[k,c,r,s] / scale[k]))
```

The scale is a vector of coefficients and must have the same size as the quantization axis.

Dequantization is performed similarly except for the pointwise operation that is defined as:

```
output[k,c,r,s] := input[k,c,r,s] * scale[k]
```

**Block Quantization**

In block quantization, elements are grouped into blocks, with all elements in a block sharing a common scale factor. Block quantization is supported for inputs of up to 3 dimensions.

INT4 block quantization supports weight-only quantization (WoQ).

FP4 block quantization supports both weights and activations. To minimize quantization error, use Dynamic Quantization for activations.

When using block quantization, the scale tensor dimensions equal the data tensor dimensions except for one dimension over which blocking is performed (the blocking axis). For example, given a 2-D RS weights input, `R` (dimension 0) as the blocking axis and `B` as the block size, the scale in the blocking axis is repeated according to the block size and can be described like this:

```
For each r in R:
    For each s in S:
        output[r,s] = clamp(round(input[r,s] / scale[ceil(r//B), s]))
```

The scale is a 2D array of coefficients with dimensions `(ceil(R//B), S)`.

Dequantization is performed similarly, except for the pointwise operation that is defined as:

```
output[r,s] = input[r,s] * scale[ceil(r//B), s]
```

## Quantized Types Rounding Modes[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html#quantized-types-rounding-modes "Link to this heading")

TensorRT primarily uses the `round-to-nearest-even` method (also known as “banker’s rounding”), which rounds ties to the nearest even value. For example, 2.5 rounds to 2 and 3.5 rounds to 4. This method helps reduce systematic bias in the quantization process, preventing the consistent upward or downward drift that can occur with other rounding strategies.

For more information about rounding modes, refer to [Rounding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rounding).

## Dynamic Quantization[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html#dynamic-quantization "Link to this heading")

Dynamic Quantization is a form of quantization in which the scales are computed during inference according to the input data. It produces two outputs: quantized data and scales. TensorRT supports Dynamic Quantization only with block quantization granularity.

Dynamic Quantization has two main benefits:

1. **Accuracy**: With Dynamic Quantization, TensorRT selects a scale that maps only the dynamic range of a single block to the quantized type. Because the dynamic range of a single block is often much smaller than the dynamic range of the entire tensor, the quantization error is reduced. This is most significant for sub-byte quantized types because of the small range of values representable in these data types.
2. **Reduced PTQ overhead**: Because TensorRT computes the scales automatically during inference, you don’t need to calibrate them using sample data.

For each block, the scale is computed by:

scale=maxi∈{0...blockSize−1}(abs(xi)qTypeMax)

Where:

- qTypeMax is the maximum value in the quantized type (such as 6 for FP4E2M1).

### MX-Compliant Dynamic Quantization[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html#mx-compliant-dynamic-quantization "Link to this heading")

Dynamic Quantization according to the [OCP Microscaling Formats (MX) Specification v1.0](https://www.opencompute.org/documents/ocp-microscaling-formats-mx-v1-0-spec-final-pdf). The MX-Compliant recipe performs block quantization, quantizing across 32 high-precision elements to produce 32 quantized output values and one E8M0 scaling factor.

TensorRT currently supports MX-Compliant Dynamic Quantization only for the FP8E4M3 vector format, referred to as MXFP8.

The scale computation for a single block is defined as:

scaleE8M0=round_up_to_e8m0(maxi∈{0...blockSize−1}(abs(xi)qTypeMax))

Where:

- E8M0 is an 8-bit exponent-only floating point type, as described in [Supported Types](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/architecture/architecture-overview.html#architecture-overview).
- round_up_to_e8m0 is the computed scale rounded up to the smallest power of two that is greater than or equal to it.
- qTypeMax is the maximum value representable in the quantized type used for data.

The scale computation is repeated for each block, computing a total of inputVolumeblockSize block scales.

### Dynamic Double Quantization[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html#dynamic-double-quantization "Link to this heading")

A variant of Dynamic Quantization, in which the computed scales are also quantized. Putting together the scale computation and scale quantization for a single block:

scalequantized=quantize(maxi∈{0...blockSize−1}(abs(xi)qTypeMax),scale=globalSf)

Where:

- globalSf is an offline-calibrated per-tensor quantization scale (scalar).

TensorRT currently supports Dynamic Double Quantization only for the NVFP4 vector format (FP4E2M1 data, FP8E4M3 scales, block size of 16).

Using qTypeMax=6 and the FP8 range of `[-448,448]`, the quantized scale can be written as:

scalefp8=castToFp8(maxi∈{0...blockSize−1}(abs(xi))6∗globalSf)

The quantized data is computed using block quantization and the computed scales.

To dequantize data that was quantized using Dynamic Double Quantization, two consecutive Dequantize operations are required (which is why it’s called *double* quantization): the first dequantizes the scales using per-tensor quantization, and the second dequantizes the data.

dataDQ=dequantize(dataQ,dequantize(scaleQ,scale=globalSf))

# TensorRT INT8 量化推理部署与校准（calibration）流程

## 0. 先确定版本路线（关键分叉）

官方文档明确了两条路线，取决于 TensorRT 版本：

| 版本 | INT8 路线 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| TensorRT 8.x – 10.x | **隐式量化**：builder 内置校准器（`IInt8Calibrator`） | 10.1 起官方标记 deprecated，被显式量化取代 |
| TensorRT 11.0+ | **显式量化（Q/DQ 网络）**：校准在 ONNX 导出前完成，尺度直接嵌入 Q/DQ 节点 | 11.0 移除了 `IInt8Calibrator` 及弱类型 API（`setPrecision`、`setDynamicRange` 等），强类型网络成为默认 |

依据：
- TRT 10.16.1 Python API 文档原文：`CalibrationAlgoType`/`IInt8Calibrator` "[DEPRECATED] Deprecated in TensorRT 10.1. Superseded by explicit quantization."（https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/10.x.x/_static/python-api/infer/Int8/Calibrator.html）
- TRT 11.0 Release Highlights 原文："Strongly typed networks are now the default: Weak-typing APIs (`setPrecision`, `setDynamicRange`, the per-precision `BuilderFlag` family) and implicit quantization (`IInt8Calibrator`) have been removed."（https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/index.html）
- TRT 最新文档原文："Calibration is performed before ONNX export (for example, during PTQ or QAT with Model Optimizer), and the resulting scales are embedded directly into the Q/DQ nodes."（https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html）

## 1. 传统校准流程（TensorRT 8.x–10.x，题目所指的核心流程）

### 1.1 原理

设置 INT8 标志后，TensorRT 对权重做对称量化（尺度取权重最大绝对值，卷积/全连接为每通道）；对**激活值**需要在代表性数据上跑前向统计分布，即校准。构建 INT8 引擎时 builder 执行三步（官方开发指南原文，NVIDIA 博客中文版第 7.3 节）：

1. 构建 32 位引擎，在校准集上运行，为每个激活张量记录分布直方图；
2. 从直方图构建校准表（每个张量一个尺度值）；
3. 根据校准表和网络定义构建 INT8 引擎。

校准表（cache）可缓存复用：只要校准发生在层融合之前（`IInt8EntropyCalibrator2`/`IInt8MinMaxCalibrator` 的默认行为，或设置 `QuantizationFlag::kCALIBRATE_BEFORE_FUSION`），校准缓存可跨平台/跨设备移植。

### 1.2 校准器选择（官方推荐）

- **`IInt8EntropyCalibrator2`**：熵校准，优化量化张量的信息论内容、抑制异常值；**CNN 类网络推荐**，DLA 必需；融合前校准（缓存可移植）
- **`IInt8MinMaxCalibrator`**：用激活分布整个范围定尺度；**NLP/BERT 类推荐**
- `IInt8EntropyCalibrator`：原始熵校准器（融合后校准）
- `IInt8LegacyCalibrator`：兼容 TRT 2.0 EA 的兜底选项，可自定义最大百分比（如 99.99%）

校准数据要求：官方经验值约 **500 张图像**即可校准 ImageNet 分类网络；数据需代表整个推理分布；INT8 I/O 时校准数据仍须为 FP32 且落在 `[-128.0F, 127.0F]`。校准是确定性的（相同设备、相同输入顺序 → 相同尺度）。

### 1.3 Python 完整代码（基于 TRT 10.x 官方 API 文档的示例代码）

```python
import tensorrt as trt
import os

class MyCalibrator(trt.IInt8EntropyCalibrator2):
    def __init__(self, batch_stream, cache_file="calibration.cache"):
        trt.IInt8EntropyCalibrator2.__init__(self)   # 必须显式初始化基类
        self.batch_stream = batch_stream
        self.cache_file = cache_file
        self.device_input = ...  # 用 pycuda/cuda alloc 分配的 device buffer

    def get_batch_size(self):
        return self.batch_stream.batch_size          # 如 NUM_IMAGES_PER_BATCH = 5

    def get_batch(self, names):                      # builder 反复调用；names 为网络输入名
        try:
            data = next(self.batches)
            cuda.memcpy_htod(self.device_input, data)
            return [int(self.device_input)]           # 返回 device 指针列表
        except StopIteration:
            return None                              # 无更多批次时返回 None/[]

    def read_calibration_cache(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.cache_file):
            with open(self.cache_file, "rb") as f:
                return f.read()                      # 有缓存则跳过重新校准

    def write_calibration_cache(self, cache):
        with open(self.cache_file, "wb") as f:
            f.write(cache)

# 构建引擎
logger = trt.Logger()
builder = trt.Builder(logger)
network = builder.create_network(1 << int(trt.NetworkDefinitionCreationFlag.EXPLICIT_BATCH))
parser = trt.OnnxParser(network, logger)
parser.parse(open("model.onnx", "rb").read())

config = builder.create_builder_config()
config.set_flag(trt.BuilderFlag.INT8)                # 启用 INT8
config.int8_calibrator = MyCalibrator(batchstream)   # 挂载校准器
engine = builder.build_engine(network, config)       # build 时自动触发校准
```

C++ 对应：实现 `IInt8Calibrator` 子类后 `config->setInt8Calibrator(calibrator.get());`，缓存读写通过 `writeCalibrationCache()`/`readCalibrationCache()`。

### 1.4 校准器接口说明（TRT 10.16.1 官方 API 文档）

- `get_batch_size()`：返回校准批次大小；builder 先查询它
- `get_batch(names)`：返回包含每个网络输入数据的**设备内存指针**列表（可用 pycuda 分配后转 int），批次大小必须与 `get_batch_size()` 一致；无数据时返回空列表/None
- `read_calibration_cache()`：返回缓存对象或 None；缓存含生成时的回归截断/分位数参数，不匹配时不会被使用；网络结构或数据集变化须重新校准
- `write_calibration_cache(cache)`：保存缓存

## 2. TRT 11.x 的现行做法（显式量化）

- 量化参数（尺度）在**ONNX 导出前**确定：用 [TensorRT Model Optimizer](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-Model-Optimizer)（Python 工具包）对 PyTorch/ONNX 模型做 PTQ（或 QAT），Q/DQ 对（ONNX `QuantizeLinear`/`DequantizeLinear`，opset 10 引入、opset 13 支持每通道 axis）嵌入模型
- 导入 TensorRT 后按 Q/DQ 语义构建引擎；QAT 网络仍需 `config->setFlag(BuilderFlag::kINT8)`（TRT 8.x 行为；11.x 强类型网络下由 Q/DQ 节点自身决定精度）
- 权重须以 FP32 指定，由 `IQuantizeLayer` 的尺度量化；TensorRT **不支持**预量化 ONNX 算子 `QLinearConv/QLinearMatmul/ConvInteger/MatmulInteger`
- Q/DQ 放置建议：量化加权运算（卷积/GEMM）的所有输入；激活每张量、权重每通道；可用 FP16 进一步降低延迟

## 3. Torch-TensorRT 封装（PyTorch 官方文档）

```python
calibrator = torch_tensorrt.ptq.DataLoaderCalibrator(
    testing_dataloader,
    cache_file="./calibration.cache",
    use_cache=False,
    algo_type=torch_tensorrt.ptq.CalibrationAlgo.ENTROPY_CALIBRATION_2,
    device=torch.device("cuda:0"),
)
trt_mod = torch_tensorrt.compile(
    model, inputs=[torch_tensorrt.Input((1, 3, 32, 32))],
    enabled_precisions={torch.float, torch.half, torch.int8},
    calibrator=calibrator, ...)
```

也有只用缓存的 `CacheCalibrator`；C++ 侧为 `torch_tensorrt::ptq::make_int8_calibrator`（默认 `IInt8EntropyCalibrator2`，可模板指定 `IInt8MinMaxCalibrator`）。

## 4. trtexec 命令行

TRT 10.x 及以前可用 `trtexec --onnx=model.onnx --int8`（可加 `--fp16`），并可配合校准缓存参数（`--calib=<cache>`）在无数据环境下复用缓存；具体参数拼写以所用版本的 `trtexec --help` 为准——**本次未从官方文档核实该参数的逐字拼写，属未核实处**。

## 5. 精度与部署注意事项（官方指南）

- 隐式量化只按性能优化，用户对 INT8 落点控制很少；显式量化完全控制 Q/DQ 边界，精度更接近框架
- 手动 `setDynamicRange` 会覆盖校准得到的动态范围
- DLA 上校准须用 `IInt8EntropyCalibrator2`；DLA 在 TRT 11.3 已不支持
- GPU 舍入模式为 round-to-nearest-even（DLA 为 away-from-zero）

## 来源

2. TensorRT 10.16.1 Python API — Int8 Calibrator：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/10.x.x/_static/python-api/infer/Int8/Calibrator.html
3. TensorRT 10.x Python API — Int8 索引：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/10.x.x/_static/python-api/infer/Int8/pyInt8.html
4. NVIDIA TensorRT Documentation (11.3.0) 入口：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/index.html
5. Working with Quantized Types (latest)：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/work-with-quantized-types.html
6. Quantization Workflows (latest)：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html

# TensorRT INT8 量化推理部署与校准（calibration）流程

## 0. 先确定版本路线（关键分叉）

官方文档明确了两条路线，取决于 TensorRT 版本：

| 版本 | INT8 路线 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| TensorRT 8.x – 10.x | **隐式量化**：builder 内置校准器（`IInt8Calibrator`） | 10.1 起官方标记 deprecated，被显式量化取代 |
| TensorRT 11.0+ | **显式量化（Q/DQ 网络）**：校准在 ONNX 导出前完成，尺度直接嵌入 Q/DQ 节点 | 11.0 移除了 `IInt8Calibrator` 及弱类型 API（`setPrecision`、`setDynamicRange` 等），强类型网络成为默认 |

依据：
- TRT 10.16.1 Python API 文档原文：`CalibrationAlgoType`/`IInt8Calibrator` "[DEPRECATED] Deprecated in TensorRT 10.1. Superseded by explicit quantization."（https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/10.x.x/_static/python-api/infer/Int8/Calibrator.html）
- TRT 11.0 Release Highlights 原文："Strongly typed networks are now the default: Weak-typing APIs (`setPrecision`, `setDynamicRange`, the per-precision `BuilderFlag` family) and implicit quantization (`IInt8Calibrator`) have been removed."（https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/index.html）
- TRT 最新文档原文："Calibration is performed before ONNX export (for example, during PTQ or QAT with Model Optimizer), and the resulting scales are embedded directly into the Q/DQ nodes."（https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/latest/inference-library/quantized-types-workflows.html）

## 1. 传统校准流程（TensorRT 8.x–10.x，题目所指的核心流程）

### 1.1 原理

设置 INT8 标志后，TensorRT 对权重做对称量化（尺度取权重最大绝对值，卷积/全连接为每通道）；对**激活值**需要在代表性数据上跑前向统计分布，即校准。构建 INT8 引擎时 builder 执行三步（官方开发指南原文，NVIDIA 博客中文版第 7.3 节）：

1. 构建 32 位引擎，在校准集上运行，为每个激活张量记录分布直方图；
2. 从直方图构建校准表（每个张量一个尺度值）；
3. 根据校准表和网络定义构建 INT8 引擎。

校准表（cache）可缓存复用：只要校准发生在层融合之前（`IInt8EntropyCalibrator2`/`IInt8MinMaxCalibrator` 的默认行为，或设置 `QuantizationFlag::kCALIBRATE_BEFORE_FUSION`），校准缓存可跨平台/跨设备移植。

### 1.2 校准器选择（官方推荐）

- **`IInt8EntropyCalibrator2`**：熵校准，优化量化张量的信息论内容、抑制异常值；**CNN 类网络推荐**，DLA 必需；融合前校准（缓存可移植）
- **`IInt8MinMaxCalibrator`**：用激活分布整个范围定尺度；**NLP/BERT 类推荐**
- `IInt8EntropyCalibrator`：原始熵校准器（融合后校准）
- `IInt8LegacyCalibrator`：兼容 TRT 2.0 EA 的兜底选项，可自定义最大百分比（如 99.99%）

校准数据要求：官方经验值约 **500 张图像**即可校准 ImageNet 分类网络；数据需代表整个推理分布；INT8 I/O 时校准数据仍须为 FP32 且落在 `[-128.0F, 127.0F]`。校准是确定性的（相同设备、相同输入顺序 → 相同尺度）。

### 1.3 Python 完整代码（基于 TRT 10.x 官方 API 文档的示例代码）

```python
import tensorrt as trt
import os

class MyCalibrator(trt.IInt8EntropyCalibrator2):
    def __init__(self, batch_stream, cache_file="calibration.cache"):
        trt.IInt8EntropyCalibrator2.__init__(self)   # 必须显式初始化基类
        self.batch_stream = batch_stream
        self.cache_file = cache_file
        self.device_input = ...  # 用 pycuda/cuda alloc 分配的 device buffer

    def get_batch_size(self):
        return self.batch_stream.batch_size          # 如 NUM_IMAGES_PER_BATCH = 5

    def get_batch(self, names):                      # builder 反复调用；names 为网络输入名
        try:
            data = next(self.batches)
            cuda.memcpy_htod(self.device_input, data)
            return [int(self.device_input)]           # 返回 device 指针列表
        except StopIteration:
            return None                              # 无更多批次时返回 None/[]

    def read_calibration_cache(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.cache_file):
            with open(self.cache_file, "rb") as f:
                return f.read()                      # 有缓存则跳过重新校准

    def write_calibration_cache(self, cache):
        with open(self.cache_file, "wb") as f:
            f.write(cache)

# 构建引擎
logger = trt.Logger()
builder = trt.Builder(logger)
network = builder.create_network(1 << int(trt.NetworkDefinitionCreationFlag.EXPLICIT_BATCH))
parser = trt.OnnxParser(network, logger)
parser.parse(open("model.onnx", "rb").read())

config = builder.create_builder_config()
config.set_flag(trt.BuilderFlag.INT8)                # 启用 INT8
config.int8_calibrator = MyCalibrator(batchstream)   # 挂载校准器
engine = builder.build_engine(network, config)       # build 时自动触发校准
```

C++ 对应：实现 `IInt8Calibrator` 子类后 `config->setInt8Calibrator(calibrator.get());`，缓存读写通过 `writeCalibrationCache()`/`readCalibrationCache()`。

### 1.4 校准器接口说明（TRT 10.16.1 官方 API 文档）

- `get_batch_size()`：返回校准批次大小；builder 先查询它
- `get_batch(names)`：返回包含每个网络输入数据的**设备内存指针**列表（可用 pycuda 分配后转 int），批次大小必须与 `get_batch_size()` 一致；无数据时返回空列表/None
- `read_calibration_cache()`：返回缓存对象或 None；缓存含生成时的回归截断/分位数参数，不匹配时不会被使用；网络结构或数据集变化须重新校准
- `write_calibration_cache(cache)`：保存缓存

## 2. TRT 11.x 的现行做法（显式量化）

- 量化参数（尺度）在**ONNX 导出前**确定：用 [TensorRT Model Optimizer](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-Model-Optimizer)（Python 工具包）对 PyTorch/ONNX 模型做 PTQ（或 QAT），Q/DQ 对（ONNX `QuantizeLinear`/`DequantizeLinear`，opset 10 引入、opset 13 支持每通道 axis）嵌入模型
- 导入 TensorRT 后按 Q/DQ 语义构建引擎；QAT 网络仍需 `config->setFlag(BuilderFlag::kINT8)`（TRT 8.x 行为；11.x 强类型网络下由 Q/DQ 节点自身决定精度）
- 权重须以 FP32 指定，由 `IQuantizeLayer` 的尺度量化；TensorRT **不支持**预量化 ONNX 算子 `QLinearConv/QLinearMatmul/ConvInteger/MatmulInteger`
- Q/DQ 放置建议：量化加权运算（卷积/GEMM）的所有输入；激活每张量、权重每通道；可用 FP16 进一步降低延迟

```python
calibrator = torch_tensorrt.ptq.DataLoaderCalibrator(
    testing_dataloader,
    cache_file="./calibration.cache",
    use_cache=False,
    algo_type=torch_tensorrt.ptq.CalibrationAlgo.ENTROPY_CALIBRATION_2,
    device=torch.device("cuda:0"),

    model, inputs=[torch_tensorrt.Input((1, 3, 32, 32))],
    enabled_precisions={torch.float, torch.half, torch.int8},
    calibrator=calibrator, ...)
```

## 4. trtexec 命令行

TRT 10.x 及以前可用 `trtexec --onnx=model.onnx --int8`（可加 `--fp16`），并可配合校准缓存参数（`--calib=<cache>`）在无数据环境下复用缓存；具体参数拼写以所用版本的 `trtexec --help` 为准——**本次未从官方文档核实该参数的逐字拼写，属未核实处**。

- 隐式量化只按性能优化，用户对 INT8 落点控制很少；显式量化完全控制 Q/DQ 边界，精度更接近框架

config.int8_calibrator = MyCalibrator(batchstream)   # 挂载校准器
engine = builder.build_engine(network, config)       # build 时自动触发校准
```

C++ 对应：实现 `IInt8Calibrator` 子类后 `config->setInt8Calibrator(calibrator.get());`，缓存读写通过 `writeCalibrationCache()`/`readCalibrationCache()`。

### 1.4 校准器接口说明（TRT 10.16.1 官方 API 文档）

- `get_batch_size()`：返回校准批次大小；builder 先查询它
- `get_batch(names)`：返回包含每个网络输入数据的**设备内存指针**列表（可用 pycuda 分配后转 int），批次大小必须与 `get_batch_size()` 一致；无数据时返回空列表/None
- `read_calibration_cache()`：返回缓存对象或 None；缓存含生成时的回归截断/分位数参数，不匹配时不会被使用；网络结构或数据集变化须重新校准
- `write_calibration_cache(cache)`：保存缓存

## 2. TRT 11.x 的现行做法（显式量化）

- 量化参数（尺度）在**ONNX 导出前**确定：用 [TensorRT Model Optimizer](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-Model-Optimizer)（Python 工具包）对 PyTorch/ONNX 模型做 PTQ（或 QAT），Q/DQ 对（ONNX `QuantizeLinear`/`DequantizeLinear`，opset 10 引入、opset 13 支持每通道 axis）嵌入模型
- 导入 TensorRT 后按 Q/DQ 语义构建引擎；QAT 网络仍需 `config->setFlag(BuilderFlag::kINT8)`（TRT 8.x 行为；11.x 强类型网络下由 Q/DQ 节点自身决定精度）
- 权重须以 FP32 指定，由 `IQuantizeLayer` 的尺度量化；TensorRT **不支持**预量化 ONNX 算子 `QLinearConv/QLinearMatmul/ConvInteger/MatmulInteger`
- Q/DQ 放置建议：量化加权运算（卷积/GEMM）的所有输入；激活每张量、权重每通道；可用 FP16 进一步降低延迟

## 3. Torch-TensorRT 封装（PyTorch 官方文档）

```python
calibrator = torch_tensorrt.ptq.DataLoaderCalibrator(
    testing_dataloader,
    cache_file="./calibration.cache",
    use_cache=False,
    algo_type=torch_tensorrt.ptq.CalibrationAlgo.ENTROPY_CALIBRATION_2,
    device=torch.device("cuda:0"),
)
trt_mod = torch_tensorrt.compile(
    model, inputs=[torch_tensorrt.Input((1, 3, 32, 32))],
    enabled_precisions={torch.float, torch.half, torch.int8},
    calibrator=calibrator, ...)
```

也有只用缓存的 `CacheCalibrator`；C++ 侧为 `torch_tensorrt::ptq::make_int8_calibrator`（默认 `IInt8EntropyCalibrator2`，可模板指定 `IInt8MinMaxCalibrator`）。

## 4. trtexec 命令行

TRT 10.x 及以前可用 `trtexec --onnx=model.onnx --int8`（可加 `--fp16`），并可配合校准缓存参数（`--calib=<cache>`）在无数据环境下复用缓存；具体参数拼写以所用版本的 `trtexec --help` 为准——**本次未从官方文档核实该参数的逐字拼写，属未核实处**。

## 5. 精度与部署注意事项（官方指南）

- 隐式量化只按性能优化，用户对 INT8 落点控制很少；显式量化完全控制 Q/DQ 边界，精度更接近框架
- 手动 `setDynamicRange` 会覆盖校准得到的动态范围
- DLA 上校准须用 `IInt8EntropyCalibrator2`；DLA 在 TRT 11.3 已不支持
- GPU 舍入模式为 round-to-nearest-even（DLA 为 away-from-zero）
